text:
Ari: Quick idea — run a micro-webinar for Data SDK users (first 2 PRs) offering 25 starter tokens + prompt template pack. Goal: lift 1st-week activation by ~8%.
Priya: love it. Do we have an audience segment? raw_query -> `sdk_activity:>=2 && plan:free` ?
Devon: I can export segment. Thinking to split 20/20/60: webinar invite / demo video / nudges with templates.
Sam: +1 on split. Can we also test in-product banner vs email? that's the main unknown.
Lena: Also want to add a benchmark narrative for launch post: show token cost per task pre/post optimization. Helps sales CTA.
Ari: Good. For experiments, propose flags:
```
exp_webinar_starterpack_v1: {
  cohorts: ["webinar_invite","demo_video","nudges_control"],
  sample_pct: 0.15,
  metrics: ["7d_activation_rate","first_30m_usage","cost_per_active_user"]
}
```
Priya: Tagging @analytics-bot to create experiment dashboard and dashboard template.
analytics-bot: Created experiment exp_webinar_starterpack_v1 — dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/dash/exp_webinar_starterpack_v1
Devon: Routing note: inbound leads from webinar -> runbook route 'marketing:webinar-db' that goes to SDR queue if MQL criteria met.
Sam: For messaging iteration, draft two headline variants: "Ship LLM features faster" vs "Lower inference cost — build fast". we'll A/B.
Lena: For the launch post, I'll draft benchmark screenshots: latency/cost vs baseline + quote from early beta.
Ari: Timeline — setup segment/export by Tue, copy for email/webinar by Wed, send cohort 1 on Thu. @eng-bot can you schedule the banner rollout for Thu 09:00 PT?
eng-bot: Banner rollout scheduled for 2024-08-22T16:00:00Z to 15% of free users in segment. Flag: rollout_webinar_banner_v1
Priya: Perfect. Quick follow-ups: 1) confirm creative assets by Wed AM, 2) confirm analytics events for 'prompt_template_download' and 'starter_token_use'.
Ari: I'll own assets, @Devon owns analytics events. Everyone ok with goals? :raised_hands:
Devon: ok
Priya: ok
Sam: ok
Lena: ok
Ari: awesome — adding notes to the playbook doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/micro-webinar-playbook
